source: Illustrative xi(r) anchor points showing the canonical power-law clustering regime and the BAO bump near the sound-horizon scale (~150 Mpc comoving, ~105 Mpc/h). These are representative order-of-magnitude landmarks reflecting the shape reported in SDSS/BOSS clustering papers, not digitized values from a specific published table.
citation: Eisenstein, D.J. et al., 2005. Detection of the baryon acoustic peak in the large-scale correlation function of SDSS luminous red galaxies. The Astrophysical Journal, 633(2), pp.560-574.
requiredCitations: Peebles, P.J.E., 1980. The large-scale structure of the universe. Princeton University Press.
Eisenstein, D.J. et al., 2005. Detection of the baryon acoustic peak in the large-scale correlation function of SDSS luminous red galaxies. The Astrophysical Journal, 633(2), pp.560-574.
